title: Codex on Vertex AI starts sending tool updates incrementally after 0.167.2
symptoms: Behavior of tool definitions changes on Google Cloud Vertex AI after updating to 0.167.2
Tool list handling differs from earlier versions with a GCP-backed provider
cause: Version 0.167.2 turned on incremental tool updates by default for Codex running against Google Cloud Vertex AI. Setups that depended on the previous full-tool behavior now get the new one without any config change.
fix: If the new behavior causes problems, opt out by setting the legacy GCP incremental tools flag to false under the [features] table in config.toml.
affected: Codex CLI 0.167.2 and later when using Google Cloud Vertex AI
